name: Ironband's Progress Report
summary: In eastern Loch Modan, troggs keep Prospector Ironband's excavation from advancing. His report asks for more blastpowder after earlier supplies were sent weeks ago.

sections.title: A Plea for Gunpowder
sections.body: Prospector Ironband's digging in Loch Modan is repeatedly disrupted by nearby troggs. His progress report, carried to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar and then sent on to the Explorers' League in Ironforge, describes the stalled work and asks for heavy munitions. League leaders already sent Ironband plenty of blastpowder weeks ago, and now wonder where those shipments went.

faq.answer: Prospector Ironband's report describes troggs disrupting his excavation in Loch Modan and asks for more blastpowder.

aliases: who do i give the report to
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm receives the report in Thelsamar, then sends it to Prospector Stormpike at the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Ironband need more blastpowder?
faq.answer: Ironband says he needs blastpowder for his digging, though nearby trogg raids may also make explosives useful for defense. Hornhelm and Stormpike believe they sent him plenty weeks ago.

faq.q: How does Prospector Stormpike react to the report?
faq.answer: Prospector Stormpike is furious at the slow progress and baffled that Ironband does not mention the large shipment sent earlier. He wonders where the missing blastpowder went.

angles.text: As a dwarf who explores or mines, you know the dangers of excavating ancient titan sites in Khaz Modan.
As a miner, you know blastpowder can clear stubborn rock, and how dangerous it is when supplies go missing in trogg territory.
